A LinkedIn lead generation agency is a firm that finds your buyers on LinkedIn, contacts them through connection requests and messages, and hands qualified conversations or meetings to your sales team. The work combines list building in Sales Navigator, message writing, account safety and follow-up across email. Done badly, it burns your profile and your brand. Done well, it is one of the few outbound channels where a senior buyer still reads a message from a stranger.

This guide compares 9 LinkedIn lead generation and outreach agencies in 2026, using each firm's own site, published pricing and Clutch profiles, all checked on 2026-10-21. You get a comparison table, review counts, entry prices and a framework to choose.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. Our reason is scope: we build and run the LinkedIn system (HeyReach, Unipile, enrichment, CRM logging) together with email and website-visitor signals, in one team. We run that same stack for our own pipeline. If you want a pure done-for-you meeting service with a lead guarantee, the lowest entry price or a large SDR team, another agency below fits better, and we name it.
Best LinkedIn lead generation agencies: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall LinkedIn outreach agency for automation-first teams: HeyReach and Unipile outreach tied to signals, enrichment and your CRM.
SalesBread: Best for manual, LinkedIn-first outreach with a money-back lead guarantee.
Cleverly: Best low entry price for small B2B teams testing LinkedIn, from $397 a month.
Belkins: Best for enterprise and mid-market sales cycles, with the largest Clutch review base on this list.
Martal Group: Best for account-based campaigns across several regions.
Leadium: Best for US-based SDRs running LinkedIn on HeyReach inside a broader outbound program.
Callbox: Best for large multichannel programs where LinkedIn is one channel among many.
Lead Cookie: Best for boutique campaigns aimed at narrow markets.
Pearl Lemon Leads: Best for UK and EU buyers who want GBP retainers.
Verified Clutch reviews by agency
Source: Clutch profile pages, checked 2026-10-21. SalesBread, Pearl Lemon Leads and ManasFlow had no Clutch profile we could find.
Quick takeaways
Only four agencies here publish a LinkedIn price: Cleverly from $397 a month, Lead Cookie from $1,500, Pearl Lemon Leads from £2,497 and Belkins from $5,000.
Belkins has the most Clutch reviews (234, rated 4.9), while Leadium and Lead Cookie hold a 5.0 rating on smaller review bases.
SalesBread is the only firm offering a money-back guarantee on its headline result: 20+ sales qualified leads a month.

1. ManasFlow, best overall LinkedIn outreach agency for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that builds and runs outbound systems, and LinkedIn is the channel we use most for our own pipeline. We run HeyReach for multi-account LinkedIn campaigns and Unipile for messaging inside our own tools, so the playbooks we set up for clients are the ones we use every week. Our HeyReach LinkedIn outreach agency service covers the full loop: account setup and safe sending limits, list building, enrichment, message sequences, reply handling and logging to your CRM.

What makes the difference is the trigger. Instead of messaging a static list, we start from signals: a visit to your pricing page, a job change, a hiring post. The website visitor outreach workflow shows one version, where an identified visitor gets scored and receives a same-day LinkedIn or email message that references the page they read.

HeyReach campaigns across several sender profiles, with safe daily limits
Unipile-based messaging and inbox handling for teams that want it inside their own tools
Enrichment and verification before any message is sent
Signal triggers: website visits, job changes, hiring and content engagement

Replies and meetings logged to HubSpot, Pipedrive, Attio or Salesforce

2. SalesBread, best for manual LinkedIn-first outreach

SalesBread is a done-for-you LinkedIn and email outreach agency that promises one qualified lead per day through personalised LinkedIn messages and warm emails. Its process covers list building, manual research and personalisation, then daily lead delivery from the client's own LinkedIn account. The site says it does not use AI at any step.
Key features
Manual research and personalisation on every message
Sales Navigator list building
Outreach from your own LinkedIn profile
Month-to-month contracts
Best for
Teams that want hand-written LinkedIn outreach and a guaranteed volume
Pricing
Custom quote
Guarantee: 20+ sales qualified leads a month or your money back
Pros
The clearest guarantee on this list
No long contract
Cons
Its site mentions a 3 to 5 week waitlist
No LinkedIn ads or content services
3. Cleverly, best low entry price

Cleverly runs done-for-you LinkedIn lead generation and says it books 10 to 30 B2B meetings a month. It also sells LinkedIn ghostwriting, profile optimisation, cold email, cold calling and outsourced SDRs. Clutch lists it as founded in 2018 with 10 to 49 employees, and shows 85 reviews at 4.3 (checked 2026-10-21).
Key features
LinkedIn outreach using Sales Navigator filters
Ghostwriting and profile optimisation
Cold email and calling add-ons
Best for
Small B2B teams testing LinkedIn on a tight budget
Pricing
LinkedIn lead generation from $397 a month
Pros
Lowest published entry price here
Large review base
Cons
A templated, volume-based model
The lowest Clutch rating in this group
4. Belkins, best for enterprise sales cycles

Belkins uses LinkedIn as a nurturing and conversion channel for long, complex sales cycles, combining human-led outreach, content and engagement with AI-supported lead tiering. It assigns a dedicated SDR and account manager and syncs with HubSpot. Clutch lists it as founded in 2017 with 50 to 249 employees, and shows 234 reviews at 4.9.
Key features
Dedicated SDR and account manager
LinkedIn, email and content combined
HubSpot sync
Best for
Mid-market and enterprise companies with long sales cycles
Pricing
Average starter price from $5,000, covering 1,500 leads a month across 3 channels
Pros
The largest Clutch review base here
Structured, account-managed delivery
Cons
Highest published entry price on this list
A multichannel program rather than a LinkedIn-only service
5. Martal Group, best for multi-region ABM

Martal Group runs LinkedIn lead generation as part of signal-driven, segmented campaigns across LinkedIn, email and phone. It names Sales Navigator and LinkedIn Account IQ, says it uses real profiles without spoofing, and has teams in North America, Europe and Latin America. Clutch lists it as founded in 2009 with 250 to 999 employees, and shows 109 reviews at 4.8.
Key features
Signal-driven prospecting
Omnichannel campaigns
Teams in three regions
Best for
Companies selling into several regions with an account-based approach
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Scale and regional coverage
Strong Clutch record
Cons
LinkedIn is bundled into a wider program
No public pricing
6. Leadium, best for US-based SDRs on HeyReach

Leadium is a Las Vegas outbound agency that books sales qualified appointments. Its LinkedIn prospecting is run by US-based SDRs, and its service page names HeyReach, Sales Navigator and dedicated static residential proxies. LinkedIn sits next to email, calling and gifting. Clutch lists it as founded in 2016 and shows 88 reviews at 5.0.
Key features
US-based SDRs handling replies
HeyReach and Sales Navigator stack
Email, calling and gifting alongside LinkedIn
Best for
US companies that want native-English SDRs on their LinkedIn conversations
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Transparent about its LinkedIn tooling
Perfect Clutch rating on a large review base
Cons
LinkedIn is rarely sold on its own
Pricing is gated behind a form
7. Callbox, best for large multichannel programs

Callbox, founded in 2004 according to its site, runs outsourced B2B lead generation across phone, email, LinkedIn, chat and events. For LinkedIn it says AI reviews a prospect's recent posts, career moves and network activity before messaging. Clutch shows 128 reviews at 4.6 and a team of 1,000 to 9,999.
Key features

LinkedIn cadence management
Large delivery team
Best for
Enterprises running high-volume programs across many markets

Custom quote

Scale and long track record

8. Lead Cookie, best for boutique campaigns
Lead Cookie runs tailored LinkedIn and email outbound campaigns. Its site lists 14 in-house experts, 800+ campaigns and nine years in business. Clutch shows 4 reviews at 5.0.
Key features
Manual targeting and message writing
LinkedIn plus email follow-up
Boutique tier for very narrow markets
Best for
Companies selling to a small, specific set of buyers
Pricing
Core outbound campaigns from $1,500 a month
Boutique outreach campaigns from $3,700 a month
Pros
Published pricing
Careful, tailored campaigns
Cons
Small team and few Clutch reviews
9. Pearl Lemon Leads, best for UK and EU buyers

Pearl Lemon Leads is a London B2B lead generation agency with offices in New York and San Francisco. Its LinkedIn service covers profile positioning, Sales Navigator list building, safe daily volumes, LinkedIn-then-email follow-up and replacement of no-show meetings. It also sells cold email, telemarketing and appointment setting.
Key features
Profile positioning before outreach
LinkedIn plus email follow-up
No-show replacement
Best for
UK and European companies that want GBP-priced retainers
Pricing
LinkedIn lead generation from £2,497 a month
The same page also quotes $200 to $1,000 per lead
Pros
Published pricing and a clear process
